sidi_bouzid_page.name: Sidi Bouzid
sidi_bouzid_page.hero_subtitle: Atlantic resort beach south of El Jadida — wider sand, seaside cafés and open ocean horizon.

overview.title: Resort strip on the Atlantic
overview.p1: Sidi Bouzid is the main resort beach south of El Jadida: longer sand, seasonal cafés and a clearer holiday mood than the urban city beach.
overview.p2: Trade winds and Atlantic swell still rule. Swimming is best in calmer spells; otherwise walk, sit and watch the horizon.
overview.p3: A short taxi from the centre makes it an easy third-day outing after the Portuguese monuments.

q1.question: How far from the medina?
q1.answer: A short taxi ride south — confirm the fare before you go.

q2.question: Better for swimming than town?
q2.answer: Often preferred for space; conditions still depend on the Atlantic.

q3.question: Facilities?
q3.answer: Cafés and seasonal services along the strip.

q4.question: Family friendly?
q4.answer: Yes when the sea is calm; watch children near the water.

q5.question: Combine with Haouzia?
q5.answer: Possible on a longer coastal afternoon with a driver.
